page.layout: One printed title page, full width; a library stamp pasted at the upper left corner (not transcribed). No margin text.
page.notes: The top line is partly hidden by the stamp "Dif. 744 /." (library stamp, not transcribed). The first line is cut off at the left edge, so its opening letters are doubtful. The ornament between "conventu pronunciata." and "Marpurgi" is a printer's flourish, shown as ⁂ and not a text character. Long s is written as s throughout, as the rules require.
